author: PopBase
text:
Political party leaders from Scotland, Wales & Northern Ireland have signed a memorandum of understanding to push for self-determination.

If successful, Scotland & Wales could leave the UK and no longer be governed by Westminster, while Northern Ireland could reunify with Ireland.
